text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no fires detected on the asset during the period from September 25, 2026, to October 24, 2026. The monitoring covered the asset daily using sensors like VIIRS (SNPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) and MODIS, but no active fire detections were recorded. The last day (October 25, 2026) was not fully covered due to near-real-time data updates, but the asset remained clear of fire activity throughout the monitored period.
